about: The game's art slots: everything the 3D view draws, by name. Read by ArtKit (client3d/art_kit.gd), the terrain pass and the art tools; the fields and conventions are in docs/art_style.md. A slot's own art goes in art/kit/<category>/<slot>/: <slot>.glb (variants <slot>.2.glb ...) with its <slot>.blend beside it, or <slot>.png for a texture slot. Until then it is drawn from its fill (a third-party piece, from 'sources') or as a grey box.

wall.straight.uses: a wall on a cell edge (Client3D._add_wall); one per edge of a run until terrain sweeps wall.profile along runs

wall.post.uses: where walls meet at an angle or a wall ends (Client3D._add_post)

wall.profile.uses: the cross-section terrain sweeps along each wall run (terrain part 4); the body below cap_y may be raised, lowered, notched or broken per segment, the band above it is kept whole

wall.rubble.uses: the blocked gap in a broken wall run: fills a whole 1 m edge, at least 0.6 m tall, so a gap never reads as a way through

door.single.uses: a door on a cell edge: the frame in the wall, its leaf swinging with the Door (Client3D._add_doorway, _sync_doors); open and closed are the leaf's swing, the other states (decision 256) are state_<name> nodes, a broken door's on its open leaf

tree.broadleaf.uses: the forest on the void round an outdoor map (Client3D._add_tree), 6 in 10 trees; sized 0.85 to 1.2, turned and nudged per cell

tree.small.uses: the forest on the void round an outdoor map (Client3D._add_tree), 4 in 10 trees; sized 0.85 to 1.2, turned and nudged per cell

tree.pine.uses: a conifer for the forest round an outdoor map and groves (not drawn yet: Client3D._add_tree picks tree.broadleaf or tree.small); sized 0.85 to 1.2, turned and nudged per cell

rock.small.uses: rocks among the forest round an outdoor map (Client3D._add_forest), turned per cell

scatter.tuft.uses: grass tufts terrain scatters over grass and dirt (terrain part 5), drawn by MultiMesh; terrain's procedural stand-in while empty

scatter.flower.uses: small flowers terrain scatters over grass (terrain part 5), drawn by MultiMesh; its colours are terrain's to tint; terrain's procedural stand-in while empty

scatter.stone.uses: pebbles and small stones terrain scatters over dirt, sand and stone (terrain part 5), drawn by MultiMesh; terrain's procedural stand-in while empty

scatter.root.uses: roots breaking the ground near trees (terrain part 5), drawn by MultiMesh, laid lengthwise along x; terrain's procedural stand-in while empty

prop.crate.uses: a crate, pushable and stackable to stand on (the crate entity; drawn as a primitive puppet until decision 264 draws it through ArtKit)

prop.chest.uses: a chest holding loot, its lid hinged at the back and lifted when opened (the chest entity; drawn as a primitive puppet until decision 264 draws it through ArtKit)

rock.boulder.uses: the boulder, heavy and pushable, that sinks in water (the boulder entity; drawn as a sphere until the slot has art of its own, decision 264)

prop.cart.uses: a hand cart, pushable, to haul loot on (the cart entity; drawn as a slab until the slot has art of its own, decision 264); its length along z

building.hut.uses: a hut, 3 x 3 cells: its roof, interior floor and trim, never walls: its walls are the map's wall edges, drawn by terrain's runs and faded per edge (buildings hides the roof and the near wall while you are inside). Origin the footprint's middle; the roof's pivot at the eaves, 3 m, the wall height

building.house.uses: a house, 4 x 6 cells, its ridge along z: its roof, interior floor and trim, never walls: its walls are the map's wall edges, drawn by terrain's runs and faded per edge (buildings hides the roof and the near wall while you are inside). Origin the footprint's middle; the roof's pivot at the eaves, 3 m, the wall height

building.shed.uses: a shed, 2 x 3 cells: its roof, interior floor and trim, never walls: its walls are the map's wall edges, drawn by terrain's runs and faded per edge (buildings hides the roof and the near wall while you are inside). Origin the footprint's middle; the roof's pivot at the eaves, 3 m, the wall height

building.well.uses: a well, 1 x 1 cell, a whole piece standing in the open: its rim and posts the body, its little roof a part (no floor; nothing to walk into)

wall.end.uses: a run's free end, capping the wall.profile section, a little proud of it

wall.corner.uses: an L joint where two runs meet at a corner, the runs' ends meeting in it along -z and +x

wall.t.uses: a T joint, a run along z met by one along +x

wall.cross.uses: a + joint, runs along z and x crossing

wall.straight_low.uses: a 1 m wall section low (1 m) on a cell edge; tiles along z, its ends the wall.profile section

wall.post_low.uses: a free-standing pillar low (1 m) at a cell corner

wall.end_low.uses: a run's free end low (1 m), capping the wall.profile section, a little proud of it

wall.corner_low.uses: an L joint low (1 m) where two runs meet at a corner, the runs' ends meeting in it along -z and +x

wall.t_low.uses: a T joint low (1 m), a run along z met by one along +x

wall.cross_low.uses: a + joint low (1 m), runs along z and x crossing

wall.straight_tall.uses: a 1 m wall section tall (4.5 m) on a cell edge; tiles along z, its ends the wall.profile section

wall.post_tall.uses: a free-standing pillar tall (4.5 m) at a cell corner

wall.end_tall.uses: a run's free end tall (4.5 m), capping the wall.profile section, a little proud of it

wall.corner_tall.uses: an L joint tall (4.5 m) where two runs meet at a corner, the runs' ends meeting in it along -z and +x

wall.t_tall.uses: a T joint tall (4.5 m), a run along z met by one along +x

wall.cross_tall.uses: a + joint tall (4.5 m), runs along z and x crossing

wall.window.uses: a 1 m wall section with an opening to see through; it still blocks movement

wall.straight_ruined.uses: a 1 m wall section with a broken top, for ruins and broken runs

wall.end_ruined.uses: a run's broken free end: rubble and a jagged stub

door.double.uses: a double door over two cell edges (2 m along z): the frame, two leaves hinged at its ends, swinging apart; open and closed are the leaves' swing

door.gate.uses: a castle gate over two cell edges (2 m along z): two heavy leaves hinged at its ends

door.portcullis.uses: a portcullis on a cell edge: the frame, and a grate that slides up into it to open

door.trapdoor.uses: a trapdoor in the floor of a cell, its top level with the floor, its lid hinged along the -z edge, lifting up

tree.dead.uses: a dead, bare tree for the forest round an outdoor map and groves; sized 0.85 to 1.2, turned and nudged per cell

tree.stump.uses: a cut or broken stump, in clearings and at the forest's edge

tree.log.uses: a fallen log lying along z

plant.bush.uses: a bush, among trees and along paths

plant.fern.uses: a fern, in the forest's shade

scatter.reeds.uses: reeds terrain scatters along water's edge (terrain part 5), drawn by MultiMesh; terrain's procedural stand-in while empty

rock.large.uses: a large rock, about 2 m, in the wilds and at cliff feet

prop.barrel.uses: a barrel (drawn as the barrel shape today)

prop.torch.uses: a wall sconce with its torch; the flame (a shader and a light) burns at its flame socket

prop.lantern.uses: a lantern, carried or hung from its hang socket; its light at the flame socket

prop.campfire.uses: a ring of stones and logs; the fire burns at its flame socket

prop.fence.uses: a 1 m fence section on a cell edge, tiling along z

prop.fence_post.uses: a fence post at a cell corner

prop.stairs.uses: stairs up one height level (0.5 m) over one cell, rising toward +z

prop.sack.uses: a sack of grain or loot

prop.grave.uses: a grave: a headstone at -z and its mound

prop.anvil.uses: the smith's anvil on its block

prop.forge.uses: the smith's forge; its fire glows at the flame socket

prop.bookshelf.uses: a bookshelf against a wall, its back toward -z

prop.market_stall.uses: a market stall: a counter under an awning

prop.signpost.uses: a signpost, its arms pointing along x

prop.banner.uses: a banner on its pole showing who holds a place; its cloth a part the game colours by faction

prop.tent.uses: a goblin tent, its opening toward +z

prop.palisade.uses: a 1 m palisade section of sharpened stakes on a cell edge, tiling along z

prop.cage.uses: a cage for a captive, its door hinged at one side

prop.bridge.uses: a plank bridge over a stream or a drop, 3 m along z, walkable along its length

prop.ladder.uses: a ladder up one wall's height, leaning on a wall toward -z

ground.grass.uses: terrain's ground shader on grass: blended, lit and noised there; procedural colour while empty

ground.dirt.uses: terrain's ground shader on dirt; procedural colour while empty

ground.stone.uses: terrain's ground shader on stone floors; procedural colour while empty

ground.sand.uses: terrain's ground shader on sand; procedural colour while empty

material.rock.uses: the cliff faces terrain generates at ledges, mapped triplanar: no up or down in it

material.wall.uses: the stone of swept wall runs (wall.profile): u is metres along the run, v metres up
